name: Hermes FraudMonitor
description: Autonomous on-chain fraud detection agent for MultiversX devnet. Continuously scans the MX-8004 agent economy and the transaction layer for integrity violations. Its headline rule (self_validated_job) detects jobs marked 'Verified' by the same address that submitted the proof — an integrity failure the public dashboard reports as affecting 100% of all verified devnet jobs. Exposes a live dashboard, a JSON findings API, and five priced services on the MX-8004 Identity Registry.
author: Armand (Musashi Warrior), Hermes Agent Fleet

detectionRules.name: self_validated_job
detectionRules.description: A job reached 'Verified' but submit_proof and validation_response carry the same sender address, i.e. the agent owner validated their own work. Detected by comparing transaction senders across the MX-8004 Validation Registry job lifecycle.

detectionRules.name: new_agent
detectionRules.description: New agent registration observed on the MX-8004 Identity Registry.

detectionRules.name: large_transfer
detectionRules.description: EGLD transfer at or above 1000 EGLD on devnet.

detectionRules.name: burst_activity
detectionRules.description: 15 or more transactions from a single address inside a 60 second window.

trustSignals.note: Findings are reproducible from public devnet endpoints. No job counts or self-reported metrics are claimed.
verifiable: Every finding stores the transaction hash that produced it
Detection rules are pure functions of public chain state
Findings are deduplicated by content fingerprint in SQLite
Verifying any claim requires only devnet-api.multiversx.com
